steps.eval: (async () => { const width = window.innerWidth; if (width < 860 || width > 1000) throw new Error('layout-900 需要以 --win 900x620 运行，当前 innerWidth=' + width); const upd = await window.api.settings.update({ layout: 'grid-3' }); if (!upd || !upd.ok) throw new Error('settings.update 失败: ' + JSON.stringify(upd)); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 650)); const root = document.querySelector('[data-scroll-root=true]'); if (!root) throw new Error('找不到内容区 [data-scroll-root]'); const documentOverflow = Math.max(document.documentElement.scrollWidth, document.body.scrollWidth) - width; if (documentOverflow > 1) throw new Error('文档横向溢出 ' + documentOverflow + 'px'); const rootOverflow = root.scrollWidth - root.clientWidth; if (rootOverflow > 1) throw new Error('内容区横向溢出 ' + rootOverflow + 'px'); const grids = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('div')).filter((el) => { if (getComputedStyle(el).display !== 'grid') return false; if (el.children.length === 0) return false; return Array.from(el.children).every((child) => child.getAttribute('role') === 'button'); }); const grid = grids.sort((a, b) => b.children.length - a.children.length)[0]; if (!grid) throw new Error('找不到卡片网格（div[display=grid] 且子元素都是 role=button）'); const rects = Array.from(grid.children).map((el) => el.getBoundingClientRect()); if (rects.length !== 4) throw new Error('卡片数量应为 4，实际 ' + rects.length); const template = getComputedStyle(grid).gridTemplateColumns; const repeatMatch = template.match(/^repeat\((\d+),/); const columns = repeatMatch ? Number(repeatMatch[1]) : template.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length; const container = +grid.getBoundingClientRect().width.toFixed(1); if (columns > 2) throw new Error('900px 下三列应降为 ≤2 列，实际 ' + columns + ' 列（容器 ' + container + 'px）'); for (let i = 0; i < rects.length; i += 1) { if (rects[i].width <= 0 || rects[i].height <= 0) throw new Error('第 ' + i + ' 张卡片尺寸为 0'); if (rects[i].left < -1 || rects[i].right > width + 1) throw new Error('第 ' + i + ' 张卡片越出视口: ' + rects[i].left + '..' + rects[i].right); for (let j = i + 1; j < rects.length; j += 1) { const h = Math.min(rects[i].right, rects[j].right) - Math.max(rects[i].left, rects[j].left); const v = Math.min(rects[i].bottom, rects[j].bottom) - Math.max(rects[i].top, rects[j].top); if (h > 1 && v > 1) throw new Error('卡片 ' + i + ' 与 ' + j + ' 重叠 ' + h.toFixed(1) + '×' + v.toFixed(1) + 'px'); } } const header = document.querySelector('header'); if (!header) throw new Error('找不到顶栏 header'); const controls = Array.from(header.querySelectorAll('button, input, [role=button], [role=combobox], [role=switch]')).filter((el) => { const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const style = getComputedStyle(el); return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0 && style.visibility !== 'hidden' && style.display !== 'none'; }); const overflowing = controls.filter((el) => { const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return rect.left < -1 || rect.right > width + 1; }); if (overflowing.length > 0) throw new Error('工具栏 ' + overflowing.length + ' 个控件越界: ' + overflowing.map((el) => el.getAttribute('aria-label') || el.tagName).join(', ')); return { width, columns, container, cards: rects.length, documentOverflow, rootOverflow, controls: controls.length }; })()
